name: Monarch Cloud Campus gas pipeline
researcher_notes: This looks like the Hope Gas Prosperity Line, not a separate pipe. The state environmental agency permit is a stormwater permit for 556.5 acres of ground disturbance for natural gas pipelines in Putnam and Mason counties. A local TV report from May or June 2026 quotes the Mason County Commission president saying Hope Gas will bring the gas to the data center property under that permit. A Herald-Dispatch story from May 2026 ties the same permit to Hope Gas's 30-mile, 24-inch line to northern Mason County. The 14-mile figure in the WSAZ story is the only place a length of 14 miles appears, and it names Monarch Cloud Campus LLC as the permit applicant, not a separate builder. It may be one permitted section of the 30-mile line. OtherEnglishNames suggestion: Monarch Cloud Campus gas pipeline. Only the WSAZ story uses close wording (a 14-mile gas pipeline proposed by Monarch Cloud Campus LLC), and it does not use that exact name, so the suggestion is weak. There is a chance it is a different pipeline, for example an on-site line built by the developer, because no source states the Hope Gas line and the 14-mile line are the same thing. No new row staged. DataCenter is already handled on the matched row.
